Nima Rahman: heads up - canary for bridge-micro-ptq showing parse_fail ~8.7% on funcall outputs (sample 400). common failures = trailing commas and lone backslashes in strings.
Zoe Park: only PTQ? ran fp32 baseline?
Nima Rahman: fp32 baseline ~0.2%. so likely quant-related.
Theo Morales: do we have replays to repro deterministically?
Nima Rahman: yes saved: s3://redwood-canaries/ptq-funcall/repro-5345.jsonl (prompt, seed, cfg).
Zoe Park: quick raw failing examples?
Nima Rahman: e.g. ``{\"tool\":\"profile\",\"args\":{\"id\":\"u42\"},}`` trailing comma; and `{\"path\":\"D:\\data\\\"}` emitted as single backslash.
Theo Morales: suspect token boundary at kvprefix concat. try A/B: kvcache ON vs OFF. Also add a sanitize rescue step (fix trailing commas, escape sequences) and a low-temp retry.
Nima Rahman: tried retry temp=0.0 -> ~22% recovery. sanitize+retry -> ~75% recovery on small sample.
Zoe Park: plan: run 2 cohorts (kvcache on/off) with strict schema logging and rescue-step tagging, include fp32 control. record kernel tags + token diffs.
infra-bot: canary queued: ptq-funcall-5345 | bridge-micro-ptq | cohorts=kvcache-on/off | samples=1000
Theo Morales: if kvcache correlates, hold PTQ rollout. also add unit in funcall harness that injects boundary tokens to catch regressions.
Nima Rahman: launching cohorts today; will post stats and curated examples in ticket in ~24h. :thumbsup:
